# eon_snapshot_hold (Resource)

Places a retention hold on an Eon snapshot so retention policy cannot delete it.

When this resource is created, the snapshot is held. When destroyed, the hold is removed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up the snapshot to hold
data "eon_snapshot" "latest" {
  id = "18618b5a-c467-4f19-acf5-b31c63ba865b"
}

# Hold a snapshot so retention policy cannot delete it
resource "eon_snapshot_hold" "compliance" {
  snapshot_id = data.eon_snapshot.latest.id
  description = "Held for compliance investigation"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `snapshot_id` (String) Eon-assigned ID of the snapshot to hold.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Note explaining why the snapshot is being held. Cleared when the hold is removed.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Eon-assigned ID of the snapshot. Mirrors `snapshot_id`.
